description: This file defines authentication-related services, including user password hashing, user authentication, and token issuance, within an API backend. It interacts with database models to verify user credentials and generate access tokens.

methods.name: str _hash_password(password: str, salt: bytes)
methods.description: Hashes a password with a given salt using PBKDF2 HMAC SHA-256 algorithm.

methods.name: bytes _salt()
methods.description: Generates a consistent salt based on environment variable, used for password hashing.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate_user(session: AsyncSession, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username and password against the database.

methods.name: str issue_token_for_user(user: User)
methods.description: Generates a JWT access token for an authenticated user.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def authenticate_user(session: AsyncSession, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[Use/
